title: k-abelian complexity of automatic sequences is regular
statement: For every integer ℓ≥2, every ℓ-automatic sequence x over a finite alphabet, and every integer k≥1, the k-abelian complexity n ↦ ρ_k^{ab}(x,n) is an ℓ-regular sequence.
tested_range: literature conjecture; Phase-0 recovers known special cases only and does not attack the general statement
notes: Posed in Parreau-Rigo-Rowland-Vandomme 2015; still listed as unresolved by Couvreur et al. 2025. Special cases are known (Thue-Morse, period-doubling, Cantor, uniformly factor-balanced and Pisot classes). This laboratory does not claim the general statement.
